Mod.Name: Unlimited GF Abilities
Mod.Author: BreDoyliesSea
Mod.Description:
Removes the 22-ability limit per GF.
• Teach a GF any number of abilities with items, without forgetting old ones with Amnesia Greens first. • The GF menu Learn list, the item teach/forget list and the junction menu's GF ability popup get as many pages as they need (Left/Right). • Saves stay in the vanilla format.
Requires the Steam 2013 English release (FF8_EN.exe). Not for the Remastered edition, other languages or the 2000 release.
